title: Privacy policy
body:
{businessName} (ABN {abn}) respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect and why.

## What we collect
- Your name, phone number and email address
- The address of the property to be cleaned and details about it
- Booking details, messages between us and payment status (we never see or store your card details — payments are handled by Stripe)
- Basic website analytics, such as which page you came from and which ad you clicked

## Why we collect it
- To give you a price, arrange and carry out your clean
- To contact you about your booking or enquiry
- To send you an invoice and keep business records
- To understand which of our advertising works

## Who we share it with
We only share your details with services we use to run the business (for example our email, SMS, payment and hosting providers), and only as needed to provide our service. We don't sell your information.

## Access notes and security codes
Please don't send us lockbox or alarm codes through the website. We ask for those by phone. Access notes are deleted automatically shortly after your job is finished.

## Text messages
We send text messages about your booking. Where we send other messages, such as review requests, you can reply STOP to opt out.

## Access and correction
You can ask to see or correct the information we hold about you by contacting us on {phone} or {email}.

## Contact
Questions or complaints about privacy: {email}.

title: Terms of service
body:
These terms apply to cleaning services provided by {businessName} (ABN {abn}).

## Prices and quotes
- Prices shown on the website are estimates based on the information you give us.
- We confirm the final price by phone before your booking is confirmed. If the property is different from what was described, we'll tell you about any change before we start.

## Bookings
- Submitting a booking request does not confirm a booking. A booking is confirmed only after we call you and agree the date and price.

## Access and the property
- You're responsible for arranging access, and for power and water being connected on the day.
- Please remove personal belongings and furniture before a vacate clean.

## Payment
- Payment is due as set out on your invoice. Any deposit paid is deducted from the final amount.

## Our guarantee
- Vacate cleans are covered by our re-clean guarantee (see the re-clean guarantee policy).

## Your rights
Nothing in these terms limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

## Contact
{phone} · {email}

title: Deposit & cancellation policy
body:
## Deposits
- When online deposits are available, you can choose to pay a deposit when you request a booking, or pay after we confirm.
- A deposit doesn't confirm your booking on its own — we still call you to confirm.
- Your deposit is deducted from the final invoice.

## If we can't do the job
If we can't confirm your requested date and we can't agree another one, we refund your deposit in full.

## Cancelling or changing your booking
- Please give us as much notice as possible.
- Cancel more than 48 hours before the scheduled start: full refund of any deposit.
- Cancel within 48 hours of the scheduled start: we may keep the deposit to cover the time we had set aside.

## How refunds are paid
Refunds go back to the card you paid with. They usually appear within 5–10 business days, depending on your bank.

## Contact
To cancel or change a booking, call {phone} or email {email}.

title: Re-clean guarantee
body:
We want your final inspection to go smoothly.

## What's covered
If your property manager or landlord finds an item on our vacate cleaning checklist that wasn't done to standard, we'll come back and re-clean that item at no charge.

## How to claim
- Contact us within 72 hours of the inspection, on {phone} or {email}.
- Send us the inspection report or the specific items that need attention.
- We'll arrange a time to return, usually within 48 hours.

## What's not covered
- Items not on our checklist, or that weren't part of the booked clean
- Damage, wear and tear, or marks that can't be removed by cleaning
- Areas that were used, or affected by others, after our clean

Nothing in this guarantee limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.
